tweets.text: Gemini Flash has always been underrated on X. Enterprises, however, can never seem to get enough of it. Best combination of price, intelligence, and speed.

The more I’ve relied on my second brain, the dumber my main brain has become. I’m realizing there’s tremendous value in carrying around a lot of facts, half-baked ideas, and loose threads in your head. Your subconscious keeps cooking. It makes connections between ideas, extends them, and generates new ones. You also have much better real-time recall during conversations, which lets you connect ideas and think faster. I believe there’s value in a second brain. figuring out how to use one without my main brain getting weaker.
